# Kaimi Venture Studio

> Kaimi builds a portfolio of focused, cash-generating businesses in markets the venture industry overlooks. We believe durable wealth isn't built by chasing the next unicorn — it's built by owning a portfolio of small, profitable companies that solve real problems for real customers.

Based in Miami, operating across LATAM and Europe. Each portfolio company runs independently with its own team. The studio contributes senior product, design, and engineering capability, operator-grade diligence, and ecosystem access.

## Thesis

The venture playbook of the last decade optimized for scale and winner-take-all markets, leaving thousands of valuable industries untouched — sectors too small, too unglamorous, or too operationally complex for traditional VCs. Kaimi builds in these markets: recruiting, talent, sports data, and the long tail of verticals where focused products generate durable revenue and compound for decades.

## What we do

- [Venture Studio Collaborations](https://kaimi.co/#collaborations): Partnering with founders and capital allocators through JVs and equity arrangements.
- [Operator Diligence](https://kaimi.co/#diligence): Product and operating expertise applied to investment decisions before capital commits.
- [Ecosystem Building](https://kaimi.co/#ecosystem): Advising on the expansion of the Miami startup ecosystem and connecting portfolio companies to founders, capital, and talent.
- [Product & Engineering](https://kaimi.co/#product): Senior product, design, and engineering execution as the studio's contributed asset.

## Portfolio

- [Augtal](https://augtal.com): AI recruiting automation SaaS for small staffing agencies and independent recruiters.
- [Aperturio](https://aperturio.com): LATAM talent placement as a conversational service — request talent via Slack or Claude Desktop.
- [Olta.football](https://olta.football): Football intelligence and storytelling platform transforming real-time match data into narratives, insights, and content.
